room.yard.title: Yard
room.yard.description: A packed-earth yard. A road runs north; a ford lies south.
room.road.title: Road
room.road.description: A cobbled road. The yard is south; a fen spreads east.
room.fen.title: Fen
room.fen.description: A sucking fen. The ground gives under every step.
room.ford.title: Ford
room.ford.description: A ford of road stones through the mire. The yard is north.
npc.horse.description: A patient bay horse with a worn saddle.
dialogue.horse.prompt: The horse flicks an ear at you.
narration.horse.mount: You swing up into the saddle.
narration.horse.dismount: You slide down from the saddle.
